svg.aria-label: Three examples. A big project you'll come back to: type projectprep, then bbq make a mail client for Windows 11. Could go either way, an afternoon or ongoing: bbq make me a website for my loveable dogs. No project needed, one sitting, one plan: bbq plan a weekend in Quebec City.
